title: Remove or repair the dead root firebase.json/.firebaserc pointing at missing files
why: Root firebase.json references firestore.rules and firestore.indexes.json relative to the repo root, but neither file exists there — both live only under learning_tracker/. `firebase deploy`/`firebase emulators:start` run from the repo root (a natural instinct since .firebaserc's project default lives there too) would fail immediately with a file-not-found error. Git history confirms firestore.rules used to live at repo root and was moved under learning_tracker/ during a restructure, with the root firebase.json/.firebaserc never cleaned up. Compounding this, no Makefile or CI workflow in the repo contains a `firebase deploy` or `firebase use` command anywhere — there is no committed, automated path from the source-controlled firestore.rules to the real deployed ruleset at all.
recommendation: Delete the root firebase.json/.firebaserc (or repoint them at learning_tracker/), and document (or automate via CI on tag/release) the actual firestore.rules deploy process.
acceptance_criteria: Root firebase.json's referenced paths exist, or the file is removed.

corrections: The 'git history confirms firestore.rules used to live at repo root and was moved under learning_tracker/' claim is backwards: learning_tracker/firestore.rules (fd0a1f25) predates the root copy, which was added later in f3777e8e as a duplicate (likely from running `firebase init` at repo root) and only partially cleaned up, leaving firebase.json/.firebaserc orphaned. Core dead-config conclusion is unaffected.
